title: Retired licensure status and its limits
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 3.04(1) a licensee may petition the Board to place a license on retired status, which is a nondisciplinary status, and the Board may decline to review any petition for reinstatement or return to current status from a licensee whose status was changed to retired. Under 247 CMR 3.04(2) eligibility requires that the license is not surrendered, suspended or revoked at the time of the petition and that the licensee demonstrates an intent to retire permanently from active practice in the Commonwealth and in all other jurisdictions. Under 247 CMR 3.04(3) a licensee with retired status may not practice, and under 247 CMR 3.04(4) retired status does not prevent the Board from initiating or pursuing disciplinary action.
exam_relevance: Tests that retired status is voluntary and nondisciplinary yet neither permits practice nor shields the licensee from Board action.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Retired status is nondisciplinary but is not a safe harbour from discipline.
The intent to retire must extend to all jurisdictions, not only Massachusetts.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 3.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
